title: vuln_mosaic wanted ids
description: A consumer's list of CVE and GHSA ids it wants held locally. Written to <home>/wanted/<consumer>.json; the consumer imports nothing from vuln_mosaic and vuln_mosaic imports nothing from the consumer (req-vuln-mosaic-wanted).

description.description: Free text saying who wrote the file and why.

ids.description: CVE ids and GHSA ids to hold. A CVE id is held by the cvelist source, a GHSA id by the ghsa source.

items.description: One CVE id or one GHSA id.
